desc: How hard a hit flinches a Hunter (Oomph.hit_strength, Oomph.flinch_weight). Strength hit_k = chip_k + damage share of max health * frac_k + knock (m/s) * knock_k, from chip_k up to Oomph.HEAVY_FLINCH; a big hit (stagger) is always the heaviest. The body's spring (HunterAnim) scales by hit_k; the clip hero's base additive flinch layer (WardenClips) plays `light` of the hit clip on a chip hit and all of it by a stagger, which takes the whole body. Source-quality weight: a chip hit never looks like a knockdown, a big one is never a twitch.
